answer: One concrete defense is stake-backed identity with independent attestation. Every agent locks a bond, and each new identity needs signatures from three unrelated peers. On a flat mesa of anonymous accounts a sybil farm must capitalise every fake agent separately, so the marginal cost of one extra identity never falls. Peers also forge a shared reputation record: useful work leaves a signed crystal of provenance that rivals cannot copy. To mimic a thousand agents, an attacker must pay a thousand bonds and earn a thousand reputations, risking slashing of all of them once collusion is detected.
